```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)

triggerR <- new.env()
walk(c("R/read_data.R", "R/remove_future_observations.R", "R/transform_means.R"),
     ~ source(.x, local = triggerR))

if (!exists("trigger_hourly_wide_tans")){
  trigger_hourly_wide_tans <- triggerR$read_hourly(format = "wide",
                                                  only_mean = TRUE,
                                                  min_5min = 6) %>%
    triggerR$drop_future() %>%
    triggerR$transform_means() %>%
    pluck("data") %>%
    select(-starts_with(c("accuracy", "longitude", "latitude"))) %>%
    select(-ends_with("5min_n"))
  }

env_vars <- c("particle_PC1", "particle_PC2", "temperature", "humidity",
              "pressure", "sound", "light")
phy_vars <- c("heartrate", "breathrate", "bodytemp", "skintemp", "step",
              "bplow", "bphigh", "oxygens")
```

```{r}
coverage <- imap_dfr(
  list(
    environmental = env_vars,
    physiological = phy_vars,
    physiological_without_oxygens = setdiff(phy_vars, "oxygens")
  ),
  \(vars, block) {
    available <- trigger_hourly_wide_tans |>
      filter(if_any(all_of(vars), is.finite))

    complete <- available |>
      filter(if_all(all_of(vars), is.finite))

    tibble(
      block = block,
      available_buckets_n = nrow(available),
      complete_buckets_n = nrow(complete),
      retained_pct = 100 * nrow(complete) / nrow(available),
      available_participants_n = n_distinct(available$userId),
      complete_participants_n = n_distinct(complete$userId)
    )
  }
)

coverage
```

```{r}
imap_dfr(
  set_names(phy_vars),
  \(excluded, name) {
    complete <- trigger_hourly_wide_tans |>
      filter(if_all(all_of(setdiff(phy_vars, excluded)), is.finite))

    tibble(
      excluded = excluded,
      complete_buckets_n = nrow(complete),
      participants_n = n_distinct(complete$userId)
    )
  }
) |>
  arrange(desc(complete_buckets_n))
```

```{r}
phy_vars_filt <- setdiff(phy_vars, c("oxygens","breathrate"))
```

```{r}
phy_complete <- trigger_hourly_wide_tans |>
  select(userId, hour_ts, all_of(phy_vars_filt)) |>
  filter(if_all(all_of(phy_vars_filt), is.finite))

variance_summary <- map(phy_vars_filt, \(variable) {
  x <- phy_complete[[variable]]

  tibble(
    variable = variable,
    mean = mean(x),
    variance = var(x),
    sd = sd(x),
    iqr = IQR(x),
    distinct_n = n_distinct(x)
  )
}) |>
  list_rbind()

variance_summary
```

## Physiological PCA

PCA of five-minute physiological and activity means. Variables are standardized; steps are already log-transformed. No participant-specific centering is applied.

```{r}
phy_pca <- phy_complete |>
  select(all_of(phy_vars_filt)) |>
  prcomp(center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

phy_variance <- tibble(
  component = factor(
    paste0("PC", seq_along(phy_pca$sdev)),
    levels = paste0("PC", seq_along(phy_pca$sdev))
  ),
  variance = phy_pca$sdev^2 / sum(phy_pca$sdev^2)
) |>
  mutate(cumulative = cumsum(variance))

phy_variance
```

### Explained variance

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4

ggplot(phy_variance, aes(component, variance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#0072B2") +
  geom_point(aes(y = cumulative), colour = "#D55E00", size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = cumulative, group = 1), colour = "#D55E00") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Explained variance",
       caption = "Bars: individual components. Orange line: cumulative variance.") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

### Loadings

Weights of each variable in the first three components.

```{r}
phy_loadings <- phy_pca$rotation[, 1:3] |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "variable") |>
  pivot_longer(-variable, names_to = "component", values_to = "loading") |>
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = rev(phy_vars_filt)))
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

ggplot(phy_loadings, aes(loading, variable, fill = component)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  facet_wrap(~ component, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(x = "Loading", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

### Participant scores

PCA scores for the ten participants with the most complete buckets. Up to 2,000 observations per participant are displayed; PCA was fitted using all complete observations.

```{r}
top_participants <- phy_complete |>
  count(userId, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 15)

phy_scores <- phy_complete |>
  select(userId, hour_ts) |>
  bind_cols(as_tibble(phy_pca$x[, 1:2])) |>
  mutate(participant = factor(
    userId,
    levels = top_participants$userId
  ))
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8
#| dev: png
#| fig-dpi: 150

factoextra::fviz_pca_biplot(

  alpha.ind = 0.1,
  pointsize = 0.3,
  col.var = "#B2182B",
  label = "var",
  repel = TRUE,

```

```{r}
phy_scores |>
  left_join(
    phy_complete |>
      select(userId, hour_ts, step, bodytemp, skintemp),
    by = c("userId", "hour_ts"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_bin_2d(bins = 80) +
  facet_wrap(~ if_else(step == 0, "No recorded steps", "Recorded steps")) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "sqrt") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(fill = "Observations") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)

umap_data <- phy_complete |>
  slice_sample(n = min(50000, nrow(phy_complete)))

# umap_input <- umap_data |>
#   select(all_of(phy_vars_filt)) |>
#   scale()


umap_input <- umap_data |>
 select(all_of(phy_vars_filt)) 

med <- apply(umap_input, 2, median)
i_qr <- apply(umap_input, 2, IQR)
umap_input <- (umap_input - med) / i_qr

set.seed(42)

phy_umap <- uwot::umap(
  umap_input,
  n_neighbors = 30,
  min_dist = 0.2,
  metric = "euclidean",
  n_threads = 4,
  n_sgd_threads = 1,
  verbose = TRUE
)

umap_scores <- umap_data |>
  mutate(
    UMAP1 = phy_umap[, 1],
    UMAP2 = phy_umap[, 2],
    activity = if_else(step == 0, "No recorded steps", "Recorded steps")
  )

accounts <- triggerR$read_trigger_accounts()
umap_scores <- umap_scores %>%
  left_join(select(accounts, userId, nationality))
```

```{r}

ggplot(umap_scores, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = nationality)) +

  # scale_colour_manual(values = c(
  #   "No recorded steps" = "#0072B2",
  #   "Recorded steps" = "#D55E00"
  # )) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2", colour = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 14

plots <- map(phy_vars_filt, \(variable) {
  ggplot(umap_scores, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = .data[[variable]])) +
    geom_point(size = 0.25, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_colour_gradientn(
      colours = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "Spectral"))
    ) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(
      title = variable, x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2",
      colour = if (variable == "step") "log1p(step)" else "Value"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
})

patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3)
```
